cases.reason: 2002 limits the exponent to 1..3 digits; 2014 and 2023 allow 4. The compiler accepts a 4-digit exponent at every edition (PictureAnalyzer.cs AnalyzeFloatEdited ~lines 1379-1388: '+' then 1..4 '9's). This is a general rule, and §2002:3.1.1 lets an implementation leave a general-rule violation unflagged, so this is weaker than the SR6 case; but at --std 2002 the compiler gives the 2014 meaning to a picture 2002 does not define, with no diagnostic and no extension flag. Reported as an edition-gate defect.
